feature_contract.goal: Propagate any nonzero original OutRun game exit as DX9Ex test failure after collecting logs, rather than treating an observed OpenXR host as successful gameplay.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Packaged direct DX9Ex launcher and its test runner only; preserve the game process, OpenXR host, telemetry, DX9Ex renderer, FFB and other branches.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source-confirmed release-blocking failure: gameExitCode was recorded by Run-OutRunVRTest.ps1 but ignored after the collector when an OpenXR host process had been observed; START_DX9EX_TEST.cmd could falsely report OK.
trace_stages: START_DX9EX_TEST.cmd selects CURRENT_FOCUS CORRECTNESS and calls Run-OutRunVRTest.ps1
The runner waits for native OR2006C2C.EXE and observes live host process
Game exit health is collected and translated to positive CMD-readable errorlevel only after log archive
subcomponents: Persist original game exit and classify nonzero game crash in DX9EX_LAUNCH_HEALTH independently of host visibility
Write session error evidence before collector and emit positive status safe for signed Windows exception return values

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Nonzero original game exit, including signed negative crash NTSTATUS, produces positive errorlevel 7 after logs are archived.
GAME_NONZERO_EXIT status, original exit code and PID are recorded and an error file is written before log collection.
Normal zero-exit sessions remain valid when host was observed, missing-host failure remains prioritized and the user's game is never killed.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Exact SHA GitHub CI and mutation
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: DX9Ex Active Windows game, host, package, Domain Isolation and changed-area mutation guard pass on the material result SHA; Quest3 remains untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The original shipped runner recorded p.ExitCode but used only xrHostFailure to determine success; observed prewarmed OpenXR host could mask an abnormally terminated game.
source_trace: Visible CMD invokes selected DX9Ex test runner
Game Start-Process -PassThru and WaitForExit gives a real exit code
Game exit failure health and original exit are written before collector then positive CMD errorlevel is returned
diagnosis.root_cause: Game exit code was a log field instead of success gate; passing a negative NTSTATUS directly would also evade CMD if errorlevel 1.
alternatives_rejected: Do not rely on OpenXR helper existence to prove native game success
Do not skip archive or terminate a running game to report error
Do not change SkyGlow, game rendering or backend selection
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Preserve native ExitCode, mark GAME_NONZERO_EXIT, persist pre-archive error and return positive 7 after log collector.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extended launcher verifier mutations reject restoring exit 0 or erasing GAME_NONZERO_EXIT.

runtime_evidence: Windows native game and Quest3/VDXR not executed in this session.
